## Preventative Maintenance Calendar

To prevent unexpected system crashes, adhere to the recommended service intervals:

| Interval | Inspection & Procedure | Sign of Compliance |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Daily** | Morning caffeine handoff + evening decompression debrief + warm hug. | Calm breathing; relaxed smile; zero buffered stress. |
| **Weekly** | Dedicated date night or quality 1-on-1 activity with zero work/chores talk. | High laughter count; renewed spark; playful banter. |
| **Monthly** | State-of-the-Union check-in: *"How are we doing? Anything we need to tweak or improve?"* | Open dialogue; mutual reassurance; zero lingering grievances. |
| **Annual** | Unplugged vacation / getaway reboot in fresh coordinates. | Full memory wipe of daily work fatigue; exciting new memories. |
